name: claude-code-mods
description: Eleven open-source Claude Code mods by OneWave AI: panes, bands, status lines and tool-call guards

plugins.name: agent-narrator
plugins.description: Watch the agent work: every step in plain English, with a live time-saved counter

plugins.name: agent-race
plugins.description: Race Claude Code sessions on a task: live split-screen race track scoreboard

plugins.name: boss-fight
plugins.description: Failing tests spawn a pixel boss; every run that fixes tests lands a hit, zero failures is a KO with loot

plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Live session cost odometer above the prompt: a burning fuse, real-world comparisons, threshold alerts

plugins.name: code-pet
plugins.description: A pixel pet that lives in a pane and reacts to what Claude does: eats on tool calls, gets sick on failures, panics on rm -rf, sleeps when idle, evolves as you ship

plugins.name: inbox-alerts
plugins.description: Gmail + Slack alerts inside Claude Code: toasts, status count, and an Alerts pane

plugins.name: inner-monologue
plugins.description: A pane of Claude's dry inner thoughts about your session, typed out live

plugins.name: launch-codes
plugins.description: Dangerous Bash commands need launch codes: red alert pane, siren, a code to arm and a LAUNCH to fire

plugins.name: session-wrapped
plugins.description: Spotify Wrapped for a Claude Code session: an animated stat reveal and a shareable PNG card

plugins.name: sportscaster
plugins.description: Live TV play-by-play of your Claude Code session, spoken aloud with crowd effects

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Mission control for subagents and agent teams: who is running, what each is doing, who spawned whom, who is talking to whom
